title: opencode-unity install manifest
description: The record of every persistent change setup and upgrade made (spec 14.2). It is the only authority uninstall has: a change that is not an entry here is never undone, and an entry whose current state no longer matches what is recorded is kept and listed instead of removed.

cliVersion.description: The CLI version that owns this installation. A command that sees a version older than the running package prints 'run opencode-unity upgrade' (spec 14.3).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, to the second.

createdBy.description: `<command>@<cliVersion>`, so an entry says which run made it.

absolutePath.description: Absolute path as the installing platform spells it. Never normalised to POSIX: uninstall has to hand this exact string back to the filesystem it came from.

createdRoot.description: The topmost directory the installer had to create to hold a file outside the product home. Uninstall removes it again, together with the empty directories below it, and only while it is empty: anything another program has put there since keeps it.

entry.description: One persistent change. `kind` picks the shape; a kind this version does not know fails validation rather than being ignored, because an unknown entry is residue uninstall would silently leave behind. Later steps add kinds by extending both lists below (S44 adds the three host kinds).

fileEntry.description: One file this product wrote. Removed only while its content still hashes to `sha256`.

dirEntry.description: A directory this product owns end to end, such as a profile directory or `xdg-config`. Uninstall removes it whole, including what OpenCode installed inside it (spec 14.4 item 2).

userEnvEntry.description: A Windows user-scope environment variable. `previous` is null when the variable did not exist, and uninstall restores it only while the current value is still the one setup wrote (spec 14.4 item 3).

launchctlEnvEntry.description: The macOS form of the same item: `launchctl setenv` so the Ollama app inherits it (amendment 38.11). Linux writes nothing at all - the value is printed for the user's own unit file (CP-D15).

ollamaModelEntry.description: A model tag in the user's Ollama store. `pulledBySetup` separates a base model this product downloaded from one that was already there; a base model is removed only when setup pulled it (spec 14.4 item 4).

derived.description: True for a tag `ollama create` built from our Modelfile, false for a base model.

wtFragmentEntry.description: The Windows Terminal fragment of spec 13.5. Its own kind because the fragment directory is Microsoft's, not ours: the file is removed, the directory only when it is left empty, and `settings.json` is never touched.

skillCopyEntry.description: A delegation skill file copied into another tool's home (spec 12.6). The host lane owns writing these; the kind exists here so uninstall can revert one by hash whichever lane wrote it.

npmGlobalEntry.description: A global npm package setup installed. Uninstall prints the removal command and never runs it, because another tool may use the same package (spec 14.4 item 5).

projectDirEntry.description: An in-project `.opencode-unity/` export written by `init --in-project`. `sha256Tree` is the tree hash of spec 6.1, so an edited export is kept rather than removed.
